name: Coating Material
description: Production rate adjustment based on the coating material being applied. Waterbased finish (latex/acrylic) is the baseline. Primer is ~20% slower than finish (rate x 0.8) because of careful uniform laydown for adhesion + thinner film build. Oil-based coatings are ~15% slower than waterbased equivalents (rate x 0.85) because of slower setup time, brush drag, and more careful brushwork to avoid lap marks. The OB_PRIMER factor combines both penalties (1.25 x 1.176 = ~1.47 = rate x 0.68). Material is auto-derived from substrate_state and coat_number: bare substrates fire primer first, factory-primed substrates skip primer. Oil-based selection is reserved for future use; only waterbased materials are wired in active scenarios. Stored as a TIME multiplier per engine convention (>=1 = slower). FORWARD-LOOKING DECLARATION: engine wiring (ctx.material_type derivation + db.factor_modifiers rows) is a follow-up. Replaces the per-substrate-state primer-vs-finish task split — primer is no longer a distinct task family, it is the same apply task fired with material_type=WB_PRIMER. Migration in progress 2026-05-05.
